objective_pt: Contar uma notícia que você leu ou ouviu ("I read that...", "Apparently..."), usar a voz passiva simples ("was arrested", "were injured") e reagir a notícias com "Really? That's awful!".

teacher.goal_pt: Aquecer falando de como a pessoa acompanha as notícias.
prompts: How do you usually get your news?
Did you hear any interesting news this week?
watchFor: Usar "a news" ou "the news are"; "news" é incontável e singular: "the news is".
Dizer "I saw in the internet"; é "I saw it online" ou "on the internet".

exercises.prompt: Did you hear about what happened downtown?
accepted: Did you hear about what happened downtown
Have you heard about what happened downtown

exercises.instruction_pt: Ouça e diga que você lê as notícias no celular.
exercises.listen: How do you usually keep up with the news?
accepted: I read the news on my phone
I usually read the news on my phone
I read it on my phone
On my phone
I usually read news on my phone
I check the news on my phone
Mostly on my phone

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Ler algo no celular é "on my phone", com "on".
commonErrors.correction_en: I read the news on my phone.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "News" é incontável e singular: "I read it", e não "I read them".
commonErrors.correction_en: I read the news on my phone.

exercises.explanation_pt: "News" termina em "s" mas é incontável e singular: "The news is terrible". Uma notícia é "a piece of news".

teacher.goal_pt: Aprender palavras de notícias e a voz passiva mais comum.
prompts: Do you trust news on social media?
watchFor: Confundir "journal" (diário, revista científica) com jornal; jornal é "newspaper".

exercises.example_en: The headline says prices are going up again.
Apparently, the concert was canceled because of the rain.
Two people were injured in the accident.
Always check the source before you share anything. It could be fake news.

exercises.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Eu li no jornal que vai ter uma greve."
accepted: I read in the newspaper that there's going to be a strike
I read in the newspaper that there will be a strike
I read in the paper that there's going to be a strike
I read in the newspaper that there is going to be a strike
I read in the news that there's going to be a strike
I saw in the newspaper that there's going to be a strike

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Jornal é "newspaper" (ou "paper"). "Journal" é diário pessoal ou revista acadêmica.
commonErrors.correction_en: I read in the newspaper that there's going to be a strike.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Vai ter" (existir) é "there's going to be" ou "there will be", e não "will have".
commonErrors.correction_en: I read in the newspaper that there's going to be a strike.

teacher.goal_pt: Pronunciar "news" (com "z" no fim) e os particípios terminados em "-ed" da voz passiva.
prompts: Say "news". Is it "news" with S or with Z?
watchFor: Pronunciar "news" com "s" sibilante; o som final é "z": "nyuz" ou "nuz".
Colocar vogal extra em "canceled" ("cancelédi"); são só duas sílabas: "CAN-seld".

exercises.prompt: Have you seen the news today?
accepted: Have you seen the news today
Did you see the news today

exercises.instruction_pt: Repita. "Arrested" tem o "-ed" como sílaba; "canceled" e "closed" não.
exercises.prompt: The man was arrested, the game was canceled, and the road was closed.
accepted: The man was arrested, the game was canceled, and the road was closed
The man was arrested, the game was cancelled, and the road was closed

exercises.instruction_pt: Em qual palavra o "-ed" é uma sílaba a mais?
exercises.explanation_pt: Depois de "t" ou "d" o "-ed" vira sílaba: arrest-ed. Em "closed" e "canceled" ele é só um "d".

teacher.goal_pt: Entender uma notícia curta e reagir de forma natural.
prompts: Did you hear? The airport was closed this morning.
watchFor: Reagir só com "Ok"; ensine "Really? What happened?", "That's awful!", "No way!".
Esquecer o "was/were" na passiva: "two people injured".

exercises.instruction_pt: Ouça a notícia e escolha o que aconteceu.
exercises.listen: Heavy rain caused flooding in the south of the city last night. Several roads were closed, but nobody was hurt.
options: Ninguém se feriu, mas algumas ruas foram fechadas.
Várias pessoas se feriram na enchente.
A chuva foi fraca e nada aconteceu.
exercises.explanation_pt: "Several roads were closed" = várias ruas foram fechadas; "nobody was hurt" = ninguém se feriu.

exercises.instruction_pt: Ouça a notícia e reaja com surpresa, perguntando o que aconteceu.
exercises.listen: Did you hear? They closed the airport this morning.
accepted: Really? What happened
No way! What happened
Seriously? What happened
What? What happened
Really? Why
Oh no! What happened
Really? Why did they close it
Wow, what happened

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "O que aconteceu?" é "What happened?". Sem "did": quando "what" é o sujeito, o verbo vai direto no passado.
commonErrors.correction_en: Really? What happened?

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Happen" não vai na passiva: "What happened?".
commonErrors.correction_en: Really? What happened?

exercises.instruction_pt: Ouça e conte a notícia: dois carros bateram e uma pessoa ficou ferida.
exercises.listen: So what happened on the highway?
accepted: Two cars crashed and one person was injured
Two cars crashed and one person was hurt
There was an accident. Two cars crashed and one person was injured
Two cars hit each other and one person was injured
Two cars collided and one person was injured
Apparently two cars crashed and one person got hurt

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Na voz passiva falta o "was": "one person was injured". Sem ele, parece que a pessoa feriu alguém.
commonErrors.correction_en: Two cars crashed and one person was injured.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Bater" (o carro) é "crash". "Beat" é bater em alguém ou vencer.
commonErrors.correction_en: Two cars crashed and one person was injured.

teacher.goal_pt: Contar uma notícia: o que, onde, quando, e reagir à notícia do outro.
prompts: Tell me about something that happened in your city recently.
What's the biggest news story this year?
watchFor: Esquecer o passado: "Yesterday the police arrest a man".
Não dizer a fonte; ensine "I read that..." e "According to...".

exercises.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Segundo o jornal, o show foi cancelado."
accepted: According to the newspaper, the concert was canceled
According to the newspaper, the show was canceled
According to the paper, the concert was canceled
According to the newspaper, the concert was cancelled
According to the news, the concert was canceled
The newspaper says the concert was canceled

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Segundo" (de acordo com) é "according to". "Second" é o número ordinal.
commonErrors.correction_en: According to the newspaper, the concert was canceled.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: É "according to", com "to".
commonErrors.correction_en: According to the newspaper, the concert was canceled.

exercises.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Pelo visto, o prefeito foi preso."
accepted: Apparently, the mayor was arrested
Apparently, the mayor has been arrested
Apparently, the mayor got arrested
It seems the mayor was arrested
It looks like the mayor was arrested

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Prefeito é "mayor". "Prefect" é outra coisa (um cargo escolar ou administrativo em alguns países).
commonErrors.correction_en: Apparently, the mayor was arrested.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Pelo visto" é "apparently" ou "it seems". "By the view" é tradução literal.
commonErrors.correction_en: Apparently, the mayor was arrested.

exercises.instruction_pt: Comente uma notícia com uma amiga.
exercises.scene_pt: Uma amiga conta que o festival de música da cidade foi cancelado.

turns.speaker: partner
turns.text: Did you hear? The music festival was canceled.

turns.speaker: you
turns.cue_pt: Mostre surpresa e pergunte por quê.
accepted: Really? Why was it canceled
No way! Why
Seriously? Why was it cancelled
What? Why was it canceled
Really? Why

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Na pergunta, o verbo vem antes do sujeito: "Why was it canceled?"
commonErrors.correction_en: Really? Why was it canceled?

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Na voz passiva a pergunta precisa de "was": "Why was it canceled?"
commonErrors.correction_en: Really? Why was it canceled?

turns.speaker: partner
turns.text: Apparently, not enough tickets were sold.

turns.speaker: you
turns.cue_pt: Diga que é uma pena e que você já tinha comprado o ingresso.
accepted: That's a shame. I'd already bought my ticket
What a shame! I had already bought a ticket
That's a pity. I'd already bought my ticket
Oh, that's a shame. I already bought my ticket
What a pity. I'd already bought a ticket

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Que pena" é "What a shame" ou "What a pity". "Pain" é dor.
commonErrors.correction_en: What a shame! I'd already bought my ticket.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: O passado e o particípio de "buy" são "bought".
commonErrors.correction_en: I'd already bought my ticket.

turns.speaker: partner
turns.text: Don't worry. According to the website, everyone will get a refund.

turns.speaker: you
turns.cue_pt: Diga que é bom saber e agradeça.
accepted: That's good to know. Thanks
Good to know, thanks
Oh, that's good to hear. Thank you
That's a relief. Thanks for telling me
Good to know. Thanks for letting me know

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Falta o sujeito: "That's good to know" (ou só "Good to know").
commonErrors.correction_en: That's good to know. Thanks.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: A expressão é "good to know".
commonErrors.correction_en: That's good to know. Thanks.

exercises.instruction_pt: Conte uma notícia recente que chamou a sua atenção.
exercises.prompt_en: Tell me about a news story that caught your attention recently. What happened, and what do you think about it?
guidelines_pt: Diga onde você viu: "I read online that..." ou "I saw on the news that...".
Conte o que aconteceu no passado, usando pelo menos uma frase na passiva ("was closed", "were injured").
Dê a sua opinião: "I think it's..." ou "It's crazy that...".

teacher.goal_pt: Fixar "news" no singular, "according to" e a passiva com "was/were".
prompts: What was canceled or closed recently in your city?

exercises.prompt: That's great news! I'm so glad to hear that.
accepted: That's great news! I'm so glad to hear that
That is great news. I am so glad to hear that

exercises.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Tenho uma boa notícia!"
accepted: I have some good news
I've got some good news
I have good news
I've got good news
I have a piece of good news
Guess what? I have good news

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "News" é incontável: "some good news" ou só "good news", nunca "a good news".
commonErrors.correction_en: I have some good news!

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Notice" é aviso. Notícia é "news".
commonErrors.correction_en: I have some good news!

exercises.instruction_pt: Qual frase está na voz passiva?
exercises.explanation_pt: Passiva = "be" + particípio: "was arrested". "The man arrested" sozinho diria que ele prendeu alguém.

exercises.sentence: Three people ___ injured in the fire.
accepted: were

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Three people" é plural e a notícia está no passado: "were injured".
commonErrors.correction_en: Three people were injured in the fire.

practice.example_en: There's some breaking news about the election.
The video went viral in just a few hours.

practice.instruction_pt: Repita. Na voz passiva, "was" fica fraco: "wuz".
practice.prompt: The bridge was closed because of the storm.
accepted: The bridge was closed because of the storm

practice.instruction_pt: Repita a frase.
practice.prompt: Apparently, the new stadium won't be ready until next year.
accepted: Apparently, the new stadium won't be ready until next year
Apparently the new stadium will not be ready until next year

practice.instruction_pt: Repita. "Injured" tem a força no começo: IN-jured.
practice.prompt: Two people were injured, but nobody was killed.
accepted: Two people were injured, but nobody was killed
Two people were injured but no one was killed
2 people were injured, but nobody was killed

practice.instruction_pt: Repita a reação a uma notícia ruim.
practice.prompt: That's terrible! I hope everyone's okay.
accepted: That's terrible! I hope everyone's okay
That's terrible. I hope everyone is OK
That is terrible, I hope everyone is okay

practice.instruction_pt: Repita a frase.
practice.prompt: According to the news, prices went up again this month.
accepted: According to the news, prices went up again this month
According to the news, prices rose again this month

practice.instruction_pt: Repita. "Did you see" costuma soar "didja see".
practice.prompt: Did you see that video that went viral?
accepted: Did you see that video that went viral
Did you see the video that went viral

practice.instruction_pt: Repita a frase com cuidado: "fake" tem o som "fêik".
practice.prompt: I'm not sure it's true. It might be fake news.
accepted: I'm not sure it's true. It might be fake news
I'm not sure it is true, it might be fake news
I am not sure it's true. It may be fake news

practice.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "A loja foi assaltada ontem à noite."
accepted: The store was robbed last night
The shop was robbed last night
The store got robbed last night
The shop got robbed last night
The store was broken into last night

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Assaltar" uma loja é "rob". "Assault" é agredir uma pessoa.
commonErrors.correction_en: The store was robbed last night.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Ontem à noite" é "last night".
commonErrors.correction_en: The store was robbed last night.

practice.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Você ficou sabendo da greve?"
accepted: Did you hear about the strike
Have you heard about the strike
Did you hear about the strike yet
Have you heard about the strike yet
Did you know about the strike

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Ficar sabendo" é "hear about".
commonErrors.correction_en: Did you hear about the strike?

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Ficar sabendo de" algo é "hear about". Greve é "strike".
commonErrors.correction_en: Did you hear about the strike?

practice.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Pelo visto, vai chover o fim de semana inteiro."
accepted: Apparently, it's going to rain all weekend
Apparently it will rain all weekend
Apparently, it's going to rain the whole weekend
Apparently it's going to rain all weekend long
Apparently, it's supposed to rain all weekend

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Pelo visto" é "apparently".
commonErrors.correction_en: Apparently, it's going to rain all weekend.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Previsão com "going to": "it's going to rain".
commonErrors.correction_en: Apparently, it's going to rain all weekend.

practice.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "O jogo foi adiado por causa da chuva."
accepted: The game was postponed because of the rain
The match was postponed because of the rain
The game was put off because of the rain
The game got postponed because of the rain
The game was postponed due to the rain
The match was postponed due to rain

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Adiar" para outro dia é "postpone" ou "put off".
commonErrors.correction_en: The game was postponed because of the rain.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Antes de substantivo, use "because of": "because of the rain".
commonErrors.correction_en: The game was postponed because of the rain.

practice.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Que notícia boa!"
accepted: What great news
That's great news
That's good news
What good news
That's such good news
Such great news

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "News" é incontável: não use "a". Diga "What great news!"
commonErrors.correction_en: What great news!

commonErrors.explanation_pt: O adjetivo vem antes: "What great news!" E notícia é "news", e não "notice".
commonErrors.correction_en: What great news!

practice.instruction_pt: Ouça e diga que leu sobre isso hoje de manhã, na internet.
practice.listen: Have you heard about the earthquake in Chile?
accepted: Yes, I read about it online this morning
Yes, I read about it this morning on the internet
Yeah, I saw it online this morning
Yes, I read about it on the internet this morning
Yes, I saw it on the news this morning

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Hoje de manhã" é "this morning".
commonErrors.correction_en: Yes, I read about it online this morning.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Na internet" é "on the internet" ou "online".
commonErrors.correction_en: Yes, I read about it online this morning.

practice.instruction_pt: Ouça e pergunte se alguém se machucou.
practice.listen: There was a big accident on the highway this morning.
accepted: Oh no! Was anyone hurt
Was anybody hurt
Was anyone injured
Oh no! Is everyone okay
Really? Was anyone injured
Oh no! Did anyone get hurt

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Na pergunta, o verbo vem antes: "Was anyone hurt?"
commonErrors.correction_en: Was anyone hurt?

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Hurt" é irregular e não muda: "hurt" no passado e no particípio.
commonErrors.correction_en: Was anyone hurt?

practice.instruction_pt: Ouça e diga que acha que é notícia falsa.
practice.listen: I read online that chocolate makes you lose weight!
accepted: I think that's fake news
That sounds like fake news
I don't believe it. It's probably fake news
Really? I think it's fake news
That's probably fake news
I'm not sure. It sounds like fake news

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "News" é incontável: "It's fake news", sem "a".
commonErrors.correction_en: I think that's fake news.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: A expressão comum é "fake news".
commonErrors.correction_en: I think that's fake news.

practice.instruction_pt: Ouça e diga onde você costuma ler notícias: no celular.
practice.listen: Where do you usually get your news?
accepted: Usually on my phone
I usually read the news on my phone
On my phone, mostly
I usually get my news on my phone
Mostly on my phone

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "No celular" é "on my phone".
commonErrors.correction_en: I usually read the news on my phone.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "News" é singular e incontável: "the news is".
commonErrors.correction_en: I usually read the news on my phone.

practice.instruction_pt: Comente uma notícia com um colega de trabalho.
practice.scene_pt: Seu colega chega atrasado e conta o que aconteceu no caminho.

turns.speaker: partner
turns.text: Sorry I'm late. The trains weren't running this morning.

turns.speaker: you
accepted: Oh no, what happened
Really? What happened
What happened
Why? What happened
Oh, what happened

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Quando "what" é o sujeito, não use "did": "What happened?"
commonErrors.correction_en: What happened?

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Diga só "What happened?"
commonErrors.correction_en: What happened?

turns.speaker: partner
turns.text: Apparently, there was a fire near the central station.

turns.speaker: you
turns.cue_pt: Reaja e pergunte se alguém se machucou.
accepted: That's terrible! Was anyone hurt
Oh no! Was anybody injured
That's awful. Was anyone hurt
How awful! Did anyone get hurt
That's terrible. Was anyone injured

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Em perguntas, use "anyone" e inverta: "Was anyone hurt?"
commonErrors.correction_en: That's terrible! Was anyone hurt?

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Falta o sujeito: "That's terrible!"
commonErrors.correction_en: That's terrible! Was anyone hurt?

turns.speaker: partner
turns.text: No, luckily. The building was evacuated in time.

turns.speaker: you
turns.cue_pt: Diga que é um alívio e pergunte como ele ficou sabendo.
accepted: What a relief! How did you find out
That's a relief. How did you hear about it
Thank goodness. How did you find out
What a relief. How did you hear
That's a relief! How did you know

commonErrors.match: ^(what a relief |that is a relief )?how you (found|heard|knew)\b
commonErrors.explanation_pt: Na pergunta no passado use "did": "How did you find out?"
commonErrors.correction_en: What a relief! How did you find out?

commonErrors.explanation_pt: O substantivo é "relief"; "relieve" é o verbo.
commonErrors.correction_en: What a relief!

turns.speaker: partner
turns.text: It was all over the news. There's a video of it going viral.

turns.speaker: you
turns.cue_pt: Diga que vai procurar o vídeo depois.
accepted: I'll look for the video later
I'll look it up later
I'll check out the video later
I'll watch it later
I'll look for it later

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Procurar" algo é "look for" ou "search for".
commonErrors.correction_en: I'll look for the video later.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Para uma decisão na hora, use "I'll".
commonErrors.correction_en: I'll look for the video later.

practice.instruction_pt: Conte uma notícia boa que você viu recentemente.
practice.prompt_en: Tell me about some good news you heard recently.
guidelines_pt: Use a voz passiva pelo menos uma vez: "was opened", "was found".
Diga o que você achou: "I was so glad to hear that...".

practice.instruction_pt: Qual frase está correta?
practice.explanation_pt: "News" é incontável e vai com verbo no singular: "The news is...".

practice.instruction_pt: Ouça e escolha o que aconteceu.
practice.listen: The concert was called off at the last minute because the singer was ill.

practice.instruction_pt: Complete com o particípio de "build": "The hospital was ___ in 1950."
accepted: built

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Build" é irregular: o particípio é "built".
commonErrors.correction_en: The hospital was built in 1950.

practice.instruction_pt: Coloque as palavras na ordem certa.
accepted: Nobody was hurt in the fire.
